text:
ashley: quick heads-up — CI microbench flagged a regression on PR #21485, microbench/batcher_scheduler p95 jumped.
perf-bot: CI artifact summary: microbench/batcher_scheduler -> baseline p95=12.3ms, PR p95=14.6ms (+18.7%), threshold=+10% -> FAIL
matt: link to CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/21485/artifacts
ashley: flame graph attached: https://perf.internal/fg/21485 — top stack shows heavy spinning in sampler::select_next
jordan: did a short bisect across the PR commits, culprit appears to be commit 34b9c2a (change: sampler prioritization -> age-based weights)
diana: that change aimed to reduce head-of-line blocking for small requests, but maybe it starves medium batches
matt: KV cache telemetry during that microbench: kv_hitrate: baseline=0.81 -> PR=0.66, evictions spike at t+3s
ashley: pasted short log snippet:
```
2026-02-10T15:12:03Z batcher: queue_len=72 sampler.select age_weight=1.8 size_weight=0.4 selected_batch=small
2026-02-10T15:12:03Z runtime:kvcache hit_rate=0.66 evictions=124
```
jordan: repro steps I used locally:
```
./tools/microbench --test batcher_scheduler --seed 430 --concurrency 16 --duration 30s
# with commit 34b9c2a -> p95 ~15ms, without -> p95 ~12ms
```
diana: my read: age-weighting prefers older small requests, causing long-lived medium batches to be delayed -> KV cache coldpath more often -> token-level latency spikes
matt: agrees. curious why unit thresholds didn't catch it earlier — the microbench samples here have a slightly different seq-length distribution; new sampler exposes that corner
ashley: proposal: revert 34b9c2a in a hotfix PR, and follow-up: add a guard in sampler to cap age_weight when queue depth > 50 and to emit sampler telemetry
matt: can we do non-revert patch that toggles to hybrid mode? quick diff idea:
```
if queue_len > 50:
  age_weight *= 0.6
```
jordan: that might mitigate, but revert is fastest to unblock rollout. I'll help test the hybrid in a follow-up PR
ashley: opening revert now and marking as rollout-blocker
ci-bot: PR 21490 opened by ashley: "revert: sampler age-weighting (34b9c2a)" — running smoke + microbench
diana: added to bisect notes: timestamped artifacts + flamegraphs, assign @matt for review
matt: reviewing now, will prioritize. good catch y'all :thumbsup:
ashley: keeping this thread for follow-up telemetry after revert completes — will post CI numbers when available.
